Bun runtime validate-phase, 2026-05-06. STATUS: Gate cleared, Option A chosen, commit-phase shipped in v1.0.0 (2026-05-07). Kept as historical record of the validation decision.

GATE (project.releasePlan v1.0.0 dependency): MCP server runs IDENTICALLY under Bun and Node when fed compiled dist/mcp-server.js. Verified via stdio JSON-RPC probe — initialize handshake completes, tools/list returns all 19 tools, stdout bytes match Node baseline exactly (25011/25011). PASS.

Versions used: Bun 1.3.13, Node v26.0.0, vitest 4.1.2, zod 4.3.6.

PASS:
- bun install (migrated package-lock.json → bun.lock, 368ms, no errors)
- bun run build (tsc clean)
- 1232/1394 tests pass via `bun --bun run test`
- Compiled mcp-server.js: byte-identical behavior under Bun vs Node

NON-BLOCKING ISSUES surfaced (all resolved or deferred):
1. vitest under Bun cannot load mcp-server.test.ts and mcp-advanced.test.ts (160 tests skipped). Workaround adopted: keep vitest under Node for tests, ship Bun for production.
2. Two entries-advanced.test.ts failures around responseSize measurement (Bun stdout capture differs from Node). Carried into project.bunMigrationScope test-runner-swap scope, not blocking.
3. Bun cannot directly execute src/mcp-server.ts (raw TS): TypeScript type-only re-export `export { Scope }`. Fixed pre-cut with `export type { Scope }` one-liner.

DECISION ADOPTED: Option A (Node-test / Bun-production split). Tests stay under vitest+Node; production binaries ship via `bun build --compile`. Test-runner swap deferred to v1.1+, see project.bunMigrationScope.
